name: Omfurn India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Omfurn India Ltd manufactures, supplies and exports Commercial and Residential Furniture[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Omfurn India specializes in manufacturing pre-finished wooden doors and modular furniture in India. It primarily undertakes turnkey projects for corporate offices, hotels, International schools, prefinished wooden doorframes, and shutters & Fire-Resistant doors for real estate developers.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 43.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 114 to 140 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -22.3%
